pr_title: Fix an e2e flake on updating node status
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind flake
/sig scheduling
/priority critical-urgent

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Some scheduler preemption e2e assumes the call to update a node's status would always succeed. But it may conflict with other node status updating actors.

This PR replaces `UpdateStatus` with `patch` so as to reduce the possibility of conflicts - all preemption test would only update the node.status.capacity on a dedicated key.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #91911

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
NONE
```

comments:
@ahg-g the error happened on updating a node:

```go
node, err := cs.CoreV1().Nodes().UpdateStatus(context.TODO(), &node, metav1.UpdateOptions{})
```

So it's less likely related with #91750. I think we should be either using patching instead of updateStatus, or retry to reduce the chances of conflicts.

I will work on a PR.

Basically I think the flake is due to other tests are updating node.status(.capacity) (such as #91243) along with the preemption tests. #91955 tries to use "patch" to replace "updateStatus".

However, one thing I cannot explains is: doesn't `[Serial]` indicate the e2e is NOT running along with others?
er, there should just be one ginkgo node in these runs AFAICT

review_comments: I think this is an improvement, but I think the error described in the issue may be misleading as I am also seeing this: `Jun  9 12:22:18.370: failed pod observation expectations: rs1 had more than 2 pods created: 3`

Are you referring to another test failure (other than `basic preemption works`)? That may be related (but I need to confirm) - the node is not updated successfully with proper "fake resource", hence the rs doesn't get expected replicas scheduled. But anyway, let focus on the `basic preemption works` failure in this PR.
Ah yes, this new failure appears to be different. I will open a separate issue :+1:
Please, thanks - I'm aware of that one: "PreemptionExecutionPath runs ReplicaSets ". Hope this one fixes that one as well.
I'm fine with this change, it should have been this way to begin with.  This probably landed before the verify job started enforcing the no-skips requirement for conformance

Yeah, that is a nice point.
All conformance tests should be operated without considering any conditions.
So it seems fine to replace Skipf with Failf to know the conformance test is operated always.

BTW I found a small thing here.
We need to put a space after `but` to distinguish it from later `all` word.

> BTW I found a small thing here.

Thanks for pointing out. Let's get it merged first to start observing the flake.
